title: bench search arm pendingDup invisibility root cause
summary: The search arm in the agent-memory bench scored 0% on real LoCoMo data because the main daemon's overlay had pendingDup=17 entries. The dup-guard fires for sessions from the same conversation (they discuss the same people/topics → cosine ≥ 0.70 mutual similarity), marking 17 of 19 session notes retrieval-invisible. The search arm called run_search(base_url=main_daemon) which hit these invisible notes and returned 0 results → 0 context → 0% accuracy. Fix: route search arm through an embedded daemon (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=<temp>) which loads a fresh overlay from graph-store only, so pendingDup={} and all 19 notes are visible. This is a separate issue from the cosine floor bug (lib/embed.js best=0, routes/graph.js !(score>0)) which was fixed by merging orch/attempt/fix-distill-search-floor.
